categories.main_business_segments: Ningbo Henghe Precision Industry Co., Ltd. focuses on the R&D and manufacturing of precision molds and precision components. Its main product lines include precision gears and gearboxes, precision structural parts, and large lightweight automotive interior and exterior parts. These products serve intelligent home appliances, automotive intelligent cockpits, and automotive lightweight applications. The company also operates subsidiaries specializing in automotive plastic parts and precision molds.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced precision mold manufacturing with high accuracy (up to ±1μm) and long mold life (up to 5 million injection cycles). It uses injection molding, multi-embedding injection technology, and automated assembly and testing equipment developed in-house. The company integrates ERP, PLM, MES, and WMS systems to enhance production management and embraces Industry 4.0 standards. R&D focuses on lightweight materials, precision transmission components, and integrated electromechanical modules.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include global home appliance brands such as Panasonic, SEB, WMF, Karcher, Toshiba, Kohler, Nidec, Xiaomi, and major automotive manufacturers and suppliers like SAIC, Geely, BYD, Leapmotor, Yanfeng, Huawei, and Kaibo. The company serves intelligent home appliances, automotive intelligent cockpits, and automotive lightweight interior and exterior parts markets, with emerging expansion into medical and communication sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with production bases in Zhejiang (Cixi, Jiaxing), Guangdong (Dongguan), and subsidiaries in Hong Kong and Malaysia. It has a global sales network serving customers in major countries and regions worldwide. Export sales accounted for over 31% of revenue in 2024, indicating significant international market presence.
categories.supply_chain_position: Ningbo Henghe Precision operates mainly in the midstream segment of the supply chain, focusing on precision component manufacturing and mold production. It extends downstream by providing integrated electromechanical modules and collaborates closely with Tier 1 and Tier 2 automotive suppliers and OEMs. The company also engages in upstream R&D and design to enhance product value.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes technological innovation in precision molds, gear transmission, automotive lightweight applications, and heat dissipation modules. It invests heavily in R&D with over 160 personnel and four dedicated departments. Strategic R&D initiatives include developing high-precision gearboxes for smart appliances, lightweight automotive plastic parts, and high-torque automotive actuators. The company aims to become a leading global system solution provider in precision manufacturing within 5-10 years.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of precision injection molded products, precision molds, metal components, and integrated modules. The company operates a direct sales model with major customers, reducing intermediaries to better control sales channels and respond to customer needs. Revenue streams include domestic and export sales, with product sales accounting for over 90% of total revenue.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company positions itself as a leading precision mold and component manufacturer in China with growing international presence. It competes with other large-scale precision manufacturing enterprises in the home appliance and automotive sectors. Its competitive advantages include advanced R&D capabilities, high-precision manufacturing, strong customer relationships with global brands, and integrated system solutions. The company is recognized as a preferred supplier by top-tier customers, creating high entry barriers for new competitors.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 751 million, a 10.83% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 38 million, up 12.18%. Total assets reached RMB 1.19 billion, with net assets of RMB 566 million. The company maintains a stable growth trajectory supported by expanding automotive intelligent cockpit and lightweight automotive parts businesses. R&D investment accounted for about 4.76% of revenue, reflecting sustained innovation efforts.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Ningbo Henghe Precision emphasizes high precision, long mold life, and integrated electromechanical solutions as its core value propositions. Its products offer superior accuracy (±1μm), durability (up to 5 million injection cycles), and lightweight advantages (20-30% weight reduction in automotive parts). The company differentiates itself through strong R&D capabilities, customized solutions for intelligent home appliances and automotive applications, and a robust quality management system ensuring stable, high-quality mass production.
